summary: Seventeen records that the first reviewers flagged as judgment calls (eleven where implemented versus in progress would change the headline, six where diverged was in play) received a fresh independent AI review that re-derived each stage from the document text and the deciding sources and stated the rubric rule applied. Five stages changed: c12-10 and c14-16 moved to implemented (nuclear modernization funding and the two-site pit plan in effect; the CY2026 outpatient payment rule began the inpatient-only list phase-out), c14-25 moved to blocked after a 2026-08-19 preliminary injunction against the Teen Pregnancy Prevention redirect, c09-19 moved from diverged to no action found (the USAID wind-down made the staffing steps moot rather than opposing them), and c11-12 moved from blocked to diverged because Congress re-enacted the indirect cost bar. Twelve stages were kept. Five calls are recorded as evenly balanced (c12-10, c15-10, c09-11, c09-19, c11-12); each record's confidence reason says so.
title: Second independent review of 17 judgment-call records
